answer: A name gets on the books only through Enrolled coin minter guild licence, because a licence minters renew after planchet audits. The forge is that a hundred names need a hundred tolls, and the farm holds only one purse. Nobody is waved through free: a deposit of 68 credits, frozen until 3 days after the grading closes is the price, and the sable never covers it twice. Every gale is counted once.
